annotation.authors_or_issuer: Österreichischer Rat für Robotik und Künstliche Intelligenz (for BMVIT)
key_provisions_or_claims: Three pillars for an Austrian robotics and AI strategy: smart governance, smart innovation, smart regulation
Four priority fields: technology/R&D/economy, work and qualification, society and law, awareness and communication
Calls for focused public R&D funding and investment priorities, with SME consideration
New European standards where existing norms are insufficient, without hampering innovation
Broad citizen and stakeholder participation to raise acceptance and address fears
annotation.summary_en: White paper of the Austrian Council on Robotics and AI, advising the transport and innovation ministry. It proposes pillars of smart governance, innovation and regulation, and four priority fields: technology/R&D, work and qualification, society and law, and public awareness. It urges focused funding, European standards and participatory strategy-making.
annotation.title_clean: Die Zukunft Österreichs mit Robotik und Künstlicher Intelligenz positiv gestalten
annotation.title_en: Shaping Austria's Future with Robotics and Artificial Intelligence Positively
annotation.venue: Bundesministerium für Verkehr, Innovation und Technologie (BMVIT) / acrai.at
